description: This file contains the implementation of a QR Code generator library in Java, including classes and methods for creating QR codes from text or binary data, handling error correction, masking, and rendering as images or SVG.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents an immutable QR Code matrix with methods for creation, rendering, and error correction.

classes.name: QrCode.Ecc
classes.description: Enumeration of error correction levels used in QR codes.

classes.name: QrCode.ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Helper class for computing Reed-Solomon error correction codewords.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Creates a QR code from a Unicode string with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeBinary
methods.description: Creates a QR code from binary data with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encodeSegments
methods.description: Creates a QR code from data segments with specified parameters.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the color of a specific module in the QR code matrix.

methods.name: toImage
methods.description: Renders the QR code as a scaled BufferedImage with border padding.

methods.name: toSvgString
methods.description: Generates an SVG string representation of the QR code with border padding.
